name: zinput_keyboard_poll_state
description: zInput::Keyboard_PollState pumps DirectInput keyboard events, updates modifier-aware key transition state, invokes raw callbacks, handles device errors, and optionally dispatches combo callbacks.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly shows DirectInput GetDeviceData, DIERR_INPUTLOST Acquire, non-input-lost DI_ReportError, modifier state updates, modifier-aware event index construction, transition-state writes, raw ASCII callback dispatch, and dispatchCallbacks-gated combo callback invocation.

VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /MD /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for zinput_keyboard_poll_state fails for 0x46f690 with 489 unmasked function-byte mismatches after masking 48 relocation bytes and trimming 2 trailing VC NOPs; the six direct keyboard polling BSS data symbols pass with zero unmasked mismatches.

The recovered keyboard helper functions are marked inline to match their no-standalone source evidence. This is byte-neutral under the active /Ob0 profile, preserves the zero-mismatch zinput_keyboard_wait_for_any_key_press target, but an /Ob1 /MD probe inlined too much and worsened 0x46f690 to 638 unmasked mismatches with a 784-byte VC body.

Direct callees 0x46fba0 zInput::Keyboard_TranslateDikToAscii and 0x472490 zInput::DI_ReportError are accepted through tier S, so the remaining keyboard polling debt is tier S function-byte drift rather than data, owner, or direct-callee coverage.
